abilities.name: Siege Mode
abilities.description: Activate to enter Siege Mode. While in Siege Mode, Basic Attacks deal 20% more damage, have 100% increased range, and deal 25% of their damage as splash damage around the target.; 2; trait

fields.notes: Sgt. Hammer cannot use her Abilities while switching into or out of Siege Mode. During Siege Mode, the casts of all Abilities are clamped at maximum range. Siege Mode can be activated or deactivated while Silenced. Polymorphs cancel Siege Mode if active, although as they are a type of Silence, Siege Mode can still be activated during the Polymorph. Damage bonus from Siege Mode stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Sgt. Hammer's Basic Attack damage. Splash damage penalty stacks multiplicatively with other offensive damage modifiers, including Siege Mode damage bonus, that can affect Sgt. Hammer's Basic Attack damage.

abilities.name: Spider Mines
abilities.description: Create 3 mines that arm after 1.25 seconds. Mines detonate when an enemy comes in range, dealing 96 damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 25% for 1.5 seconds. yellowtext Siege Mode: Cast range increased by 100%. Spider Mine

fields.notes: Spider Mines are Unstoppable and immune to Skillshots and AoE. Spider Mines are placed at the same (~1.2) distance from each other regardless of range. Spider Mines last 35 seconds after arming.

abilities.name: Concussive Blast
abilities.description: Deal 141 damage to enemies in front of Sgt. Hammer and knock them back. yellowtext Siege Mode: Radius increased by 50%.

abilities.name: Neosteel Plating
abilities.description: Gain 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Yellowtext Siege Mode: Grants 100% more Armor.

fields.notes: Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack.

abilities.name: Siege Thrusters
abilities.description: Increase Movement Speed by 60% for 4 seconds. Thrusters are always active while at the Altar. Activating Thrusters cancels Siege Mode.

fields.notes: There is no cast time when using Siege Thrusters to leave Siege Mode.

talents.name: Ambush
talents.description: Gain Stealth when entering Siege Mode or after not taking or dealing damage for 3 seconds while in Siege Mode. Basic Attacks while Stealthed deal 125% more damage. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

fields.notes: Ambush has a 0.1875 second grace time after leaving Stealth to benefit from the damage bonus. Does not benefit from other sources of Stealth. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Sgt. Hammer's Basic Attack damage.
